description:
LAMP WITH A HIDDEN FAULT, PARTIALLY OBSERVABLE

One agent, R, must get the lamp running. The lamp may have a fault.

Skills (one skill per decision cycle):
  Start(agent, lamp): try to start the lamp. A faulty lamp never starts, and even a
    healthy one sometimes fails to start. The status is ok if the lamp is running afterwards.
  Inspect(agent, lamp): look the lamp over. The reading (looks_faulty | looks_fine) is
    usually, but not always, right about whether it is faulty. Status ok.
  Repair(agent, lamp): work on the stopped lamp. Repairing sometimes clears a fault and
    never causes one. Status ok whenever the repair was carried out.

Hidden: whether the lamp is faulty is decided at random at the start and never shown directly.

Observed after every skill: whether the lamp is running, the skill's status (ok | fail), and after Inspect the reading.

Rewards: -0.01 per cycle, an extra -0.05 per repair, +1 when the lamp runs. Discount 0.95.

The probabilities are NOT given: model each one as a named parameter.

    The status is ok if the lid is open afterwards.
  Tap(agent, chest): tap the closed lid. Tapping sometimes frees a stuck lid and never sticks a free

VAULT BEHIND A DOOR THAT MAY BE LOCKED, PARTIALLY OBSERVABLE

Two agents, P and Q, start in the corridor. Rooms hall_a and hall_b lie along it, and the vault lies behind a door
that opens from hall_b. The task succeeds when both agents are in the vault.

Skills (one skill per decision cycle):
  Goto(agent, room), room in {hall_a, hall_b}: walk to a room. A room holds one agent at
    a time, and an agent never goes to the room it is already in.
    The passage is one person wide: P cannot get past Q into hall_b while Q is in hall_a;
    such a Goto fails and the agent stays.
  EnterVault(agent, door): from hall_b, step through the door into the vault. A locked door
    refuses entry and the agent stays. An agent in the vault stays there.
  Unlock(agent, door): from hall_b, unlock the door with the key; afterwards it is certainly
    unlocked. Status ok.
  Knock(agent, door): from hall_b, knock on the door. The echo (dull | hollow) is usually, but
    not always, dull when the door is locked and hollow when it is not. Status ok.

Hidden: whether the door starts locked is decided at random and never shown directly.

Observed after every skill: where each agent is (a room, the vault, or the corridor), the skill's
status (ok | fail), and after Knock the echo.

Rewards: -0.05 per agent per cycle, an extra -0.02 per unlock, +5 per agent when both are in the vault. Discount 0.98.

The probabilities are NOT given: model each one as a named parameter.

CRATE THAT MAY BE HEAVY, PARTIALLY OBSERVABLE

Two agents, A and B, must raise the crate together. It has two grip spots, front and back.

Skills (one skill per decision cycle):
  Approach(agent, spot), spot in {front, back}: step to a grip spot. A spot holds one agent,
    and an agent never approaches the spot it already holds. Status ok.
  JointLift(agent, crate, partner): the agent on front and the partner on back lift together.
    A heavy crate never comes up. Even a light crate sometimes slips back down. The status is ok if the
    crate is raised afterwards.
  Probe(agent, crate): the agent on front tests the weight. The feel (strains | easy) is
    usually, but not always, right about whether the crate is heavy. Status ok.

Hidden: whether the crate is heavy is decided at random at the start, never changes, and is never
shown directly.

Observed after every skill: which spot each agent holds, whether the crate is raised, the skill's
status (ok | fail), and after Probe the feel.

Rewards: -0.01 per agent per cycle, an extra -0.1 per probe, +1 per agent when the crate is raised. Discount 0.9.

  Approach(agent, spot), spot in {front, back}: step to a grip spot. A spot holds one agent,
    and an agent never approaches the spot it already holds. Status ok.
  JointLift(agent, engine, partner): the agent on front and the partner on back lift together.
    A heavy crate never comes up. Even a light crate sometimes slips back down. The status is ok if the
    crate is raised afterwards.
  Probe(agent, engine): the agent on front tests the weight. The feel (strains | easy) is
    usually, but not always, right about whether the crate is heavy. Status ok.

Hidden: whether the crate is heavy is decided at random at the start, never changes, and is never
shown directly.

Observed after every skill: which spot each agent holds, whether the crate is raised, the skill's
status (ok | fail), and after Probe the feel.

Rewards: -0.01 per agent per cycle, an extra -0.1 per probe, +1 per agent when the crate is raised. Discount 0.9.

The probabilities are NOT given: model each one as a named parameter.
